dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: So many resumes are sent in every day only for me to find none that can be used. What's the point?

dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: The Akademiya welcomes talent from all walks of life. After all, the talented are best known by the want of them.

dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: But some co-workers of mine are rash to recommend everyone. My desk is now inundated with piles of resumes.

dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: With all due respect, most of them... are just garbage.

dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: The more imbeciles we take in, the more stupid things we'll have to deal with every day. It threatens our efficiency. I don't know what's on their mind.

dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: Goodbye, I hope there will be more true talent coming to the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not even one can be used?

dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: I'm not saying that there's not a single capable candidate, but it's so rare.

dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: As for students who graduated from the Akademiya, they may not have working experience, but they have developed good research habits and attitude in years of study.

dialogues.speaker: Kemia
dialogues.text: We should give our own students more chances instead of recruiting untrustworthy outsiders with fake reputations.
